topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Inheriting Grandma’s house, my sister and I have a lot to sort through, but there’s a warmth that makes it easier. We’re combing through rooms filled with memories, deciding what to keep and what to let go. It feels right to do this together, just like when we were kids and would play hide and seek among these very walls. We’re finding old photo albums, her favorite recipes scribbled on yellowing paper, and my sister gently sets aside Grandma’s quilts for her children. It’s a bittersweet process, but there’s comfort in knowing we can carry on her legacy in our own ways, keeping her spirit alive in the things we treasure.
